verdict.rationale: Stripe's refunds docs say you can refund all or part of a successful payment, and that refunds can be issued through either the Refunds API or the Dashboard. That covers full and partial amounts across both channels; Payment Links also list no-code refunds. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the Dashboard and API partial-refund flows, and deeper detail on partial-refund mechanics in the Dashboard.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can issue full or partial refunds from both the dashboard and the API

citations.quote: Or you can refund all or part of a payment after it succeeds, which might incur a fee.
You can issue refunds by using the Refunds API or the Dashboard
You can view your refunded payments in the Dashboard
